brief: My balcony is full sun with high moisture, and no pets live in the household. A rooftop terrace with full sun and a shared rain barrel that keeps the soil wet. No pets, I just want a lush look.

design.site_summary: A full-sun rooftop terrace with high soil moisture from a shared rain barrel and no pets in the household.
design.layout_strategy: The scheme is structured in three height layers: trailing plants spill downward from hanging baskets at the outer edge, upright architectural shrubs anchor the mid-height containers against the back wall, and moisture-loving perennials form a lush ground layer in wide low troughs along the terrace floor.
design.combination_logic: The combination creates a lush tropical feel through contrasting leaf textures, combining sword-like upright foliage with feathery plumes and broad, glossy leaves. Seasonal interest is driven by summer blooms and autumn foliage shifts, while the rich interplay of dark greens and bright chartreuse foliage maintains a vibrant palette even when plants are not in flower.

zones.placement: on the outer railing, exposed to full all-day sun and constant moisture

plants.why: Thrives in the constant high moisture of the rain barrel system and full sun.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a bright chartreuse waterfall effect that spills over the edge, contrasting sharply with the darker greens below.

plants.why: Loves heat, sun, and abundant moisture.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds large, heart-shaped leaves and deep purple foliage color to anchor the hanging baskets with rich contrast.

maintenance: Water daily during peak summer heat to maintain the high moisture requirement.
Feed with a balanced liquid fertilizer every two weeks in spring and summer.
Trim trailing stems monthly to maintain shape and encourage bushier growth.

zones.placement: against the rear wall, receiving full sun and benefiting from self-watering mid-size containers

plants.why: Enjoys permanently wet soil and full sun.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides strong vertical architectural lines with umbrella-like tops that contrast with the mounding and trailing plants.

plants.why: Thrives in consistently damp conditions and full sun.
plants.role_in_combination: Brings massive, tropical, elephant-ear foliage that creates a lush, jungle-like aesthetic.

maintenance: Ensure water reservoirs never dry out due to the high moisture preference.
Apply a high-nitrogen slow-release fertilizer in early spring.
Cut back dead stalks in late autumn after the first frost.

zones.placement: along the base of the terrace walls in wide low troughs, full sun with high moisture

plants.why: Prefers damp, boggy soils and handles full sun if moisture is constant.
plants.role_in_combination: Forms dense, grass-like tufts of golden-striped foliage that soften the edges of the heavy containers.

plants.why: Requires moist soil to prevent scorching in full sun.
plants.role_in_combination: Offers fern-like foliage and feathery pink flower plumes in mid-summer for textural and seasonal contrast.

maintenance: Keep soil consistently wet using the rain barrel water supply.
Remove spent flower spikes after summer blooming to keep the foliage looking tidy.
Divide overcrowded clumps every three years in early spring.

care_instructions.task: Check soil moisture levels across all containers
care_instructions.frequency: daily in summer, twice a week in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Apply balanced liquid fertilizer to support rapid lush growth
Clear away dead leaves and debris from the base of the plants to prevent fungal issues

care_cautions: Despite high soil moisture needs, ensure the hanging baskets have adequate drainage holes so that stagnant water does not cause root rot during prolonged heavy rain.
The umbrella papyrus and taro will suffer leaf scorch if the rain barrel supply fails and the containers dry out completely under full sun.
Astilbe may experience leaf burn in mid-summer if the combination of full sun and high ambient temperatures temporarily outpaces the soil moisture.
design.pet_safety_note: There are no pets in the household, so this lush scheme focuses purely on aesthetic impact and environmental tolerances without needing to restrict toxic plants.
